## Business
Hungerfill Foods imports, trades and distributes premium frozen seafood, poultry, meat, eggs and specialty food products including dates, ghee, vegetables, grains, fruits, cheese and dairy. The company serves B2B buyers across the UAE and GCC with halal-certified meat and poultry.
